Page heads the Atsina/Pendleton/Stricsek group 'PGY II' twice; stored as PGY 1 (they are PGY II in 2013-14). First CC attempt failed (cluster.idx size), succeeded on retry.
gap_details.2013-2014: Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2013-48 (2013-12-18); same content in CC-MAIN-2014-10 (2014-03-12).
gap_details.2014-2015: Wayback 2014-10-09. INCOMPLETE: PGY VII lists only Krieger, Williams, Salas; Sonia Teufack (Geschwindt) and Chengyuan Wu (PGY VI in 2013-14, alumni-page graduates 2015) are not listed. Not reconstructed (brief allows manual rows only for years with no capture); their 2015 completion is in training_history. PHASE 2: resolved. Archived fellow-alumni.html (Wayback 2017-09-01) lists Geschwindt (Skull Base) and Wu (Functional) as 2015 Jefferson FELLOW alumni as well as 2015 residency graduates: their PGY7 was an enfolded fellowship year, so they sat on the fellow list, not the resident list. Only two staff.html captures exist in 2014-15 (2014-10-09, 2015-10-18 stale). Added as reconstructed PGY7 rows.
gap_details.2015-2016: Page not updated until early 2016 (2015-10 capture still showed the 2014-15 roster). Used 2016-05-18, content-dated 2015-16 (PGY-1 = Al-Saiegh/Sabourin/Stefanelli).
gap_details.2018-2019: Page carried the 2017-18 roster through 2019-01; used 2019-02-01, the first 2018-19 content (PGY-1 = Philipp/Mahtabfar/Atallah).
gap_details.2022-2023: Sep-Oct 2022 captures had no PGY-1 section; used 2022-11-03.
gap_details.2024-2025: Aug 2024 captures still showed 2023-24; the only 2024-25 content is 2025-05-04 (PGY-1 = Kumar/Sathe/Tucci).
gap_details.2025-2026: Only capture with 2025-26 content is Wayback 2026-09-24, which is identical to the live page fetched 2026-09-27 (PGY-1 = Filo class, PGY-7 = Andrews class, who were PGY-1 in 2019-20). Loaded as 2025-26.
gap_details.2026-2027: Live page (2026-09-27) not advanced: same as the 2025-26 roster, no 2026 interns, 2026 graduates still listed as PGY-7, and the alumni page has no 2026 class. Not loaded. No other source tried beyond the program site, Wayback and Common Crawl. PHASE 2: live residents.html and residency.html re-fetched 2026-09-28: unchanged, no 2026 match/intern names.
